thread:
anna_pm: Quick sync 1 KeyLoom is asking to pilot cross-cloud KMS + SSO integration for marketplace listing. Need ops + announcement timeline.

james_sales: Theyre asking for a co-announcement in early July. Is that doable? :calendar:

mira_eng: Early July will be tight. We need a week of BYOK KMS tests (AWS + GCP), plus at least 48h of SAML end-to-end runs.

oliver_security: We'll also need HSM attestation docs and an updated threat model for private deployment customers. Legal will require signoff before public comms.

partner_ops: From KeyLoom: they can shift public date by up to one week if necessary, but want the marketplace tile visible to partners the same day as the announcement.

anna_pm: Proposed plan: (a) KMS BYOK test window: 7 days, (b) SAML + SCIM smoke tests: 3 days, (c) HSM compliance packet: 5 days in parallel. Can any of these be shortened?

mira_eng: We can run SAML/SCIM in parallel with KMS. The HSM rotation scenario needs a small infra tweak  about 2 engineering days for the PKCS#11 shim tweak.

oliver_security: I'll own the risk doc. KeyLoom must provide their FIPS cert and PKCS#11 compatibility statement by EOD Tuesday.

james_sales: I'll nudge them now. Also confirm embargo preferences  they want a 48-hour embargo.

partner_ops: Confirmed: KeyLoom will provide certs Tue morning and can join smoke tests Wed. Embargo ok. We'll need a staging marketplace tile for partner preview.

mira_eng: For SCIM attribute mapping, let's reuse our org schema so smoke harness stays simple. Mapping example: externalId -> id, emails -> primaryEmail, groups -> groupNames. Example mapping snippet below:
```json
{
  "externalId": "user.external_id",
  "emails": "user.email",
  "groups": "user.groups[]"
}
```
Use this for the SCIM smoke harness.

anna_pm: Who will create the staging tile? Product + Marketing?

james_sales: Marketing will author the copy; I'll pair with product to push the tile. Eng-ops, can you create a service account with marketplace-scoped role for the tile?

devops_bot: Ticket INF-8241 created: "marketplace/staging/tile-keyloom" assigned to eng-ops. ETA 2d.

mira_eng: Also routing policy note: when customers select KeyLoom KMS, route requests through dedicated crypto pool in us-west1 to hit latency targets. Need a policy rule entry.

partner_ops: KeyLoom requests a clear fallback UX if the HSM handshake fails  prefer a message offering "switch to hosted KMS" and an actionable error.

oliver_security: Agreed. Implement automatic fallback to hosted KMS with incident tag #keyloom-kms-fallback and notify oncall for 5xx/handshake errors. Log full details to secure audit trail.

anna_pm: Owners recap: KeyLoom certs (partner_ops); infra routing + fallback (mira_eng + eng-ops); HSM attestation + risk doc (oliver_security); marketplace tile + copy (james_sales + marketing). Targets: staging preview 2026-07-02, announce 2026-07-09 (48h embargo).

james_sales: I'll confirm dates with KeyLoom and Legal today.

partner_ops: Confirmed on our side. We'll share certs Tue AM and join smoke tests Wed.

anna_pm: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping me to escalate. :thumbsup:
